options.label: Server commands
options.help: It may run raw server commands (fill, summon, ...).

options.label: Custom powers
options.help: The custom powers written in config.yml.

options.label: Rites
options.help: Gifts and blessings come with a particle rite and a chime.

options.label: How it arrives
options.help: rift: its body steps out of a tear in the air. storm: it condenses out of a particle storm.

options.label: Explosions break blocks
options.help: Off: its explosions hurt but leave the land whole.

options.label: Block changes
options.help: Most blocks one power may change at once.

options.label: Explosion power
options.help: The strongest explosion it may make (TNT is 4).

options.label: Mobs per summon
options.help: Most creatures one summoning may bring.

options.label: Rivalries
options.help: Gods sharing a world keep bonds: alliances, truces, taunts, sabotage and holy wars.

options.label: Holy days
options.help: Gods proclaim festivals, trials, hunts, omens and holy wars, with a countdown bar.

options.label: Holy day reminder
options.help: Remind a god to hold a holy day after this long without one (0: never).

options.label: Raids
options.help: Gods may send waves of raiders at a mortal they dislike. Survivable, and announced.

options.label: Moods in the world
options.help: Its feelings touch the world: storms in wrath, quick crops in joy, bold mobs at night.

options.label: Mood strength
options.help: How much its moods change weather, time and mobs.

options.label: Painted relics
options.help: Gods forge relics with their own art. COSTLY: a stronger model paints each one.

options.label: Relics a day
options.help: How many relics one god may forge in a day.

options.label: Relic power
options.help: How much power a god may imbue one relic with (0 = none).

options.label: Servants
options.help: Gods may summon angels, imps, shades, priests and temple guards.

options.label: Servants per god
options.help: How many servants one god may keep at once (lesser gods half).

options.label: True form warning
options.help: Seconds of warning before the gaze strikes.

options.label: True form reach
options.help: How far away its gaze reaches.
